name: Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Barbara
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Barbara is located in the town center of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterland. The apartment is simply furnished and offers a kitchen and a terrace where guests can relax. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking and walks in the surrounding mountains. Guests can reach the Naturschutzgebiet Kaiserwinkl and the Walchsee in just a few minutes. Parking is available. Ebbs offers local dining and shopping facilities for daily needs.
